title: Skales plugin manifest
description: The shape of a plugin.json in a plugin repository, and of one entry in the registry's plugins.json.

id.description: Reverse-DNS identity derived from the source host: com.github.<owner>/<slug>. The owner segment must match the owner of the repository the plugin is served from.

publicKey.description: Optional. The author's ed25519 public key (base64 SPKI DER). If your releases ship a SIGNATURE file, this key is what turns 'not modified since signing' into 'published by you' - Skales shows your name on the green line.

minAppVersion.description: Lowest Skales app version the plugin runs on.

description.description: One sentence. What it does, not what it promises.

class.description: page renders a surface, agent answers with a model, automation runs on a schedule or a trigger.

network.description: true means the plugin may reach hosts outside the app.

filesystem.description: none is no disk access at all; pluginRoot is the plugin's own directory and nothing above it.

tools.description: App tool names the plugin may call. Empty array means none.

business.description: Optional. Present only if the plugin is paid or has a paid tier.

repo.description: GitHub repository the plugin is served from, as owner/name.

path.description: Optional subdirectory inside repo that holds the plugin. Omit if the plugin is at the repository root.

firstParty.description: Maintained by Skales. Only entries owned by skalesapp may set this.

addedAt.description: Date the entry was merged into the registry, ISO 8601 date.
